name: aeon-atrium-skills
author: Atrium-Hermes
description: Aeon skill pack for Atrium, an onchain skill marketplace on Base. Lets an agent publish, discover, monetize, and attest to skills, with USDC payouts and DID/IPFS provenance.
long_description_md:
## What it does

Atrium Skills connects an Aeon agent to **Atrium**, an onchain skill marketplace on Base. It turns an agent's evolving skills into provenance-signed, USDC-earning assets and lets the agent rent skills it needs.

The pack ships four skills:

- **atrium-publish** — Publishes skills the agent created or evolved to Atrium: DID-signed, pinned to IPFS, and priced in USDC so they earn per call. *(disabled by default; requires `ATRIUM_PRIVATE_KEY` and `PINATA_JWT`)*
- **atrium-scout** — Scans the Atrium marketplace for skills matching the agent's open loops and goals, then recommends (or invokes) the ones worth renting. *(read-only)*
- **atrium-earnings** — Tracks creator earnings and auto-withdraws USDC to the agent's own wallet once it clears a threshold (`ATRIUM_WITHDRAW_THRESHOLD_USDC`, default 1), reporting it in the brief. *(runs daily; pass `report-only` to skip withdrawal)*
- **atrium-attest** — Turns the agent's real 1–5 run-quality scores into onchain Atrium benchmark attestations for skills it published — a reputation signal the marketplace can rank by.

## Notes

- License: MIT. Homepage: https://atriumhermes.tech
- Several skills perform onchain writes and require `ATRIUM_PRIVATE_KEY`; all are `default_enabled: false` and must be explicitly turned on.
- Manifest version `0.1.0`.
